column3: The Hebrew calls the utterance a good word and his works for the king; BSB says noble theme and verses.
The Hebrew says grace was poured on the lips and therefore God blessed him; BSB says grace anointed them since God blessed him.
The Hebrew names a thigh and does not separately express appear; BSB says side and supplies appear.
The Hebrew makes his right hand teach him awesome things; BSB describes showing awesome deeds.
The Hebrew has a singular heart, says arrows are sharpened, and does not separately express feet; BSB describes piercing hearts beneath his feet.
The Hebrew repeats scepter; BSB names justice itself as the scepter.
The Hebrew identifies all the garments with spices without a separate fragrant; BSB supplies fragrant.
The Hebrew says see; BSB says consider.
The Hebrew names his face as what the wealthy entreat; BSB says seek your favor.
The Hebrew says within without explicitly naming a chamber; BSB supplies her chamber.
The Hebrew names embroidery and companions behind her; BSB says colorful garments and omits behind her.
The Hebrew has joys in the plural; BSB says joy.
The Hebrew repeats generation; BSB says all generations.
